# gelu

> Evaluate the [Gaussian error linear unit][gelu] (GELU).

<section class="intro">

The [Gaussian error linear unit][gelu] (GELU) activation function is defined as:

<!-- <equation class="equation" label="eq:gelu" align="center" raw="\mathrm{gelu}(x) = x \cdot \Phi(x) = \frac{x}{2} \, \mathrm{erfc}\left( -\frac{x}{\sqrt{2}} \right)" alt="Gaussian error linear unit."> -->

```math
\mathrm{gelu}(x) = x \cdot \Phi(x) = \frac{x}{2} \, \mathrm{erfc}\left( -\frac{x}{\sqrt{2}} \right)
```

<!-- </equation> -->

where $\Phi(x)$ is the cumulative distribution function of the standard normal distribution and $\mathrm{erfc}(x)$ is the [complementary error function][@stdlib/math/base/special/erfc].

</section>

<!-- /.intro -->

<section class="usage">

## Usage

```javascript
var gelu = require( '@stdlib/math/base/special/gelu' );
```

#### gelu( x )

Evaluates the Gaussian Error Linear Unit (GELU) activation function.

```javascript
var v = gelu( 0.0 );
// returns 0.0

v = gelu( 1.0 );
// returns ~0.8413

v = gelu( -Infinity );
// returns -0.0

v = gelu( Infinity );
// returns Infinity

v = gelu( NaN );
// returns NaN
```

#### gelu.tanh( x )

Evaluates the Gaussian Error Linear Unit (GELU) activation function using a tanh approximation:

<!-- <equation class="equation" label="eq:gelu_tanh_approximation" align="center" raw="\mathrm{gelu}(x) \approx \frac{x}{2} \left( 1 + \tanh\left( \sqrt{\frac{2}{\pi}} \left( x + 0.044715 \, x^3 \right) \right) \right)" alt="GELU tanh approximation."> -->

```math
\mathrm{gelu}(x) \approx \frac{x}{2} \left( 1 + \tanh\left( \sqrt{\frac{2}{\pi}} \left( x + 0.044715 \, x^3 \right) \right) \right)
```

<!-- </equation> -->

```javascript
var v = gelu.tanh( 0.0 );
// returns 0.0

v = gelu.tanh( 1.0 );
// returns ~0.8412

v = gelu.tanh( -Infinity );
// returns -0.0

v = gelu.tanh( Infinity );
// returns Infinity

v = gelu.tanh( NaN );
// returns NaN
```

#### gelu.quick( x )

Evaluates the Gaussian Error Linear Unit (GELU) activation function using a quick 1.702 approximation:

<!-- <equation class="equation" label="eq:gelu_quick_approximation" align="center" raw="\mathrm{gelu}(x) \approx x \cdot \operatorname{expit}( 1.702 \, x )" alt="GELU quick approximation."> -->

```math
\mathrm{gelu}(x) \approx x \cdot \operatorname{expit}( 1.702 \, x )
```

<!-- </equation> -->

```javascript
var v = gelu.quick( 0.0 );
// returns 0.0

v = gelu.quick( 1.0 );
// returns ~0.8458

v = gelu.quick( -Infinity );
// returns -0.0

v = gelu.quick( Infinity );
// returns Infinity

v = gelu.quick( NaN );
// returns NaN
```

</section>

<!-- /.usage -->

<section class="examples">

## Examples

<!-- eslint no-undef: "error" -->

```javascript
var logEachMap = require( '@stdlib/console/log-each-map' );
var uniform = require( '@stdlib/random/array/uniform' );
var gelu = require( '@stdlib/math/base/special/gelu' );

var opts = {
    'dtype': 'float64'
};
var x = uniform( 100, -5.0, 5.0, opts );

logEachMap( 'gelu(%0.4f) = %0.4f', x, gelu );
logEachMap( 'gelu.tanh(%0.4f) = %0.4f', x, gelu.tanh );
logEachMap( 'gelu.quick(%0.4f) = %0.4f', x, gelu.quick );
```

</section>

<!-- /.examples -->
